description: An older grey-haired man in a pale toga sits at a wooden desk in a marble colonnaded library with shelves of scrolls, writing on a long unrolled scroll. Behind him a large painted wall mural shows two crowned men in Roman armor clasping arms, a wolf above, a burning city with smoke, and Roman legionaries with red shields and spears. A few robed figures stand in the background. The scroll marks are illegible squiggles, and a small sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. The painting fills the image edge to edge.
